items.statement: The reported computational route classifies optimized minima and transition states using vibrational frequencies and checks transition-state connectivity.
items.expected: Submission provides zero-imaginary-frequency minima, one-relevant-imaginary-frequency TS assignments, and IRC or justified equivalent connectivity evidence for TS-1 and TS-2.

items.statement: The activation free energy from [2a]•+ to TS-1 is approximately 1.9 kcal/mol.
items.expected: Submitted TS-1 barrier is numerically close to 1.9 kcal/mol with stated reference state and units.

items.statement: The activation free energy from Int-1 to TS-2 is approximately 4.6 kcal/mol.
items.expected: Submitted TS-2 barrier is numerically close to 4.6 kcal/mol with stated reference state and units.

items.statement: The C4-forming pathway is lower in barrier than the alternative C5-forming pathway.
items.expected: Submission identifies C4 as lower and provides a computed comparison to the C5 alternative.
